questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: 'She _______ to school by bus every weekday morning.'
questions.explanation: In Simple Present Tense, third-person singular (he/she/it) takes '-es' for 'go' -> 'goes'.

questions.prompt: 'Look! The students are playing football right now.' uses the Present Continuous Tense.
questions.explanation: 'are playing ... right now' is the standard Present Continuous form for actions happening at the moment.

questions.prompt: Which question word is used to ask about nationalities/origins: '_______ are you from?'
questions.explanation: 'Where are you from?' is used to ask someone's place of origin or nationality.

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence in Simple Present Tense for third-person singular:
choices: He watches documentary films on weekends.
He watch documentary films on weekends.
He is watch documentary films on weekends.
He watching documentary films on weekends.
questions.correctAnswer: He watches documentary films on weekends.
questions.explanation: In Simple Present Tense, verbs ending in '-ch' take '-es' with third-person singular subjects (He watches).

questions.prompt: Which preposition of time is used with exact clock times (e.g., 'The lesson starts ___ 08:30 AM')?
questions.explanation: We use the preposition 'at' for precise clock times (e.g. at 08:30 AM, at noon).
